items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: he still stayed on that trombone, the brass band. Steve, what is Steve's other name?

ctx.x: And did he ever change your order?
No, he still stayed on that trombone, the brass band. Steve, what is Steve's other name? I can't call his other name.
Is he still around today? No, he's gone.
